record.source_text: (6) Taxpayers who are required to keep books under commercial law provisions, and bookkeeping taxpayers engaged in agriculture and forestry, may have a business year that deviates from the calendar year; in such case, the profit shall be taken into account when determining income for the calendar year in which the business year ends.
